newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 695 tonnes of cotton for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 695 tonnes of cotton for sale.

text.p: Syria's general foreign trade organisation for chemicals and foodstuffs (Geza) has offered 695 tonnes of cotton lint for export, a Geza spokesman said on Thursday.
He told Reuters an international call for bids has been issued and Feburary 27 was set as final date to receive price offers. Results would be issued by March 31 at the latest.
The official said Geza would not accept offers from agents or brokers.
